blocker.cause: processor0/ and processor1/ still held intermediate (0.0001) and converged (384) timestep dirs from the preceding compute_totals run; check_totals's fresh primal tried to checkpoint into 0.0001 and DAFoam's move logic errored on the pre-existing directory instead of overwriting.

rows.note: 11.43% is the (Jan-Jfd) vector norm relative to Jfd norm; the two vectors' own magnitudes (Jan=6.460294e-02, Jfd=6.489575e-02) agree to 0.451%. Disagreement is directional (per-component), not a scale/bias error.
0/0, expected: pure geometric constraints do not depend on flow speed/AoA

interpretation: Geometric constraints (volcon/thickcon/rcon wrt shape) verify to 4.4e-14-1.4e-10 relative error, i.e. machine precision -- same FFD/DVGeo Jacobian chain as the CD/CL shape derivatives, proving the harness itself is sound.
Flow-parameter derivatives (wrt patchV) verify to 0.232% for both CD and CL -- tight, same order of magnitude as this lab's naca0015_sail coarse-case flow-parameter agreement (0.017%/0.032%).
CD wrt shape: 11.43% relative error on the difference-vector norm, but the two vectors' magnitudes agree to 0.451% -- the disagreement is directional (per-component), not a systematic scale error.
CL wrt shape: 1.67% relative error, within the 'few percent, not a failure' calibration range.

This is the official unmodified tutorial at default settings; ~11% FD-vs-adjoint disagreement on the shape gradient is what this problem class produces out of the box here -- recorded as a calibration data point for this installation/problem class, not a general law (n=1 case).

Prior-session investigation on this same case (PROOF.md, np=4) localized the disagreement to 3 of 8 shape components (idx0, idx1 near the leading edge, idx6 the LE combo mode) that survive 3.65x mesh refinement, and identified forceMeshWaveFrozen=True (frozen wall-distance in the adjoint) as a candidate (not proven) mechanism. This run's aggregate 11.43% figure is consistent with that prior, independently-run finding.
blocker_summary: check_totals attempt 1 failed due to stale processorN/ state from the prior compute_totals run; fixed by removing processor0/1 and rerunning (attempt 2, accepted).
lesson: Do not launch a task that reruns the primal from 0/ (e.g. check_totals) into a case directory still holding processorN/ state from a previous container invocation, even a successful one -- DAFoam's checkpoint-move logic errors on pre-existing timestep directories rather than overwriting them. rm -rf processor* (as sudo, container writes as root against the host bind mount) between independent task invocations on the same case dir; DAFoam redecomposes automatically from 0/ + constant/polyMesh/ at MPI startup.
